top_selection.comment: A package is 'top' if it falls within the top X% of cumulative download mass in its ecosystem

downloads_score.comment: downloads_score = debian_weight*debian_avg + homebrew_weight*homebrew_avg. Default ratio 1.39:1 is inverse of ecosystem totals (debian ~181.9M vs homebrew ~252.8M annual installs) so a 'typical' package from either ecosystem contributes equally.

value_classes.comment: Cumulative PageRank share cutoffs: A <= 50%, B <= 75%, C <= 90%, D > 90%

risk_input.comment: Risk pipeline runs on repos whose value-data.csv class is in this list.

issue_debt.comment: min_opened_5y is the master skip threshold — below this we don't classify the repo at all (issue tracker disabled / unused)

issue_trend.comment: trend_score = (slope_closed - slope_opened) / mean(opened_per_year). >= +0.05 → improving; <= -0.05 → deteriorating; otherwise stable. Empty if total < min_total_for_trend or fewer than min_active_years had any issues opened.

security.comment: Buckets the OpenSSF Scorecard score (0-10). A: score ≤ 3 (critical hygiene); B: ≤ 5; C: ≤ 7; D: > 7. Empty when no scorecard available.

funding.comment: funding_class by github_sponsors count (upper bounds): A = 0 sponsors, B = 1-10, C = 11-100, D = 101+. Empty when the sponsor count is unknown.
